India Faces Heavy Rains, Flooding, and Related Disruptions

Several parts of India are experiencing heavy rainfall, leading to waterlogging, flood preparedness measures, and disruptions. In Karnataka, authorities are implementing new trekking rules and responding to flood risks, while the High Court has intervened in government decisions regarding criminal cases and proceedings against an officer. Meanwhile, heavy rains in other regions have prompted work-from-home advisories and affected market prices.
